screenshots.label: Meadow, the last wave: a packed-earth road in a red brick curb through deep green grass, three players at their towers, a boss coming in through lightning
Desert: sandstone flags and a paved plaza across bright sand, red outcrops and teal pools, four players with their third-level branches named over their cursors
The volcano: a pale ash road between lava pools, a crimson crowd marching into beams, arc lightning and napalm, each player's storm charging
A crystal vale: pale flagstones over violet ground, a crowd burning on a napalm patch, prism, lance and blizzard towers with their level crowns
